meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把 Python（Flask、Django、FastAPI）代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux；缺少资源组、服务计划和 Web App 时会自动创建，部署完成后只打印一条部署后提示就结束。
howto.when: 当你提到「Flask App Service」「Django App Service」等关键词，或要求把 Python 代码部署到 App Service Linux 时触发；不适用于 Container Apps、Functions 等场景。

say.text: 把这个 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service Linux
say.note: 会创建缺失的资源组、计划与 Web App 并部署

say.text: 把名为 myapp 的 FastAPI 应用部署到 App Service
say.note: FastAPI 会自动设置 uvicorn 启动命令

say.text: 我的项目里有 azure.yaml，帮我部署到 App Service
say.note: 检测到 azure.yaml 时走 azd 部署路径

howto.what_en: Claude can deploy Python (Flask, Django, FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux, creating the resource group, plan, and web app if missing, then printing a post-deploy message and stopping.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "Flask App Service", "Django App Service" and similar phrases, or ask to deploy Python code to App Service Linux. Not for Container Apps, Functions, and similar.

say_en.text: Deploy this Flask app to Azure App Service Linux.
Deploy my FastAPI app named myapp to App Service.
My project has azure.yaml — deploy it to App Service.
